name: Survey Design
description: Formulation of survey objectives, sampling frames, stratification and questionnaire design for national socio-economic surveys.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No exposure to survey methodology.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Familiar with survey stages, standard terminology, and basic questionnaire concepts.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can assist in questionnaire drafting and pre-testing under senior guidance.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Independently designs questionnaires, sampling schedules, and field validation rules.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Designs large-scale multi-subject survey instruments and complex stratified designs.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Sets national survey standards, international harmonisation protocols, and innovative frame methods.

name: Sampling Methods
description: Theory and application of probability sampling: Simple Random, Stratified, Systematic, Multi-Stage Cluster Sampling and estimation formulas.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No sampling background.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands random sampling vs non-probability sampling concepts.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can compute basic sample sizes and execute simple random or stratified selection.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Implements multi-stage stratified sampling designs with sampling weights and multiplier calculations.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Calibrates sample weights, handles non-response adjustments, and computes complex design effects (DEFF).

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Designs cutting-edge sampling methodologies for nationwide household and enterprise censuses.

name: National Accounts Statistics
description: System of National Accounts (SNA), Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Value Added (GVA), Supply-Use Tables and institutional sector accounts.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No national accounts exposure.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands broad macroeconomic aggregates such as GDP, GVA, and base years.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can compile routine secondary data series from administrative records for single industries.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Independently computes sectoral GVA using production and income approaches.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Constructs Supply and Use Tables, double deflation indices, and sequence of accounts.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Directs base year revisions and implements international SNA recommendations.

name: Price Statistics (CPI / WPI)
description: Compilation of Consumer Price Index (CPI), Wholesale Price Index (WPI), Laspeyres formula, item basket weighting and elementary aggregate index calculation.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No price index experience.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Knows how inflation is reported and what CPI and WPI represent.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Validates price quotes and detects extreme outliers in market quotations.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Compiles commodity group indices, applies quality adjustments, and calculates headline inflation.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Designs weighting diagrams from household expenditure surveys and handles disappearing varieties.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Leads national price index revisions and international comparison programs (ICP).

name: Labour & Employment Statistics (PLFS)
description: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) concepts: Usual Status (ps+ss), Current Weekly Status (CWS), Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), and Worker Population Ratio (WPR).

levels.name: None
levels.description: No labour statistics background.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands definitions of labour force, employment, and unemployment.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Can verify activity status codes and classify formal vs informal employment.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Derives key employment indicators (LFPR, WPR, UR) from raw unit-level survey data.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Conducts longitudinal analyses across quarterly rotation panels and analyzes precarious work.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Sets national employment statistics framework aligned with ILO standards.

name: Statistical Inference & Estimation
description: Hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, regression modelling, maximum likelihood estimation, and non-parametric statistics.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No statistical inference background.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Knows p-values, null hypotheses, and normal distribution basics.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Performs t-tests, ANOVA, and simple linear regression with interpretation.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Builds multivariate regression models, checks diagnostics, and conducts post-hoc tests.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Applies GLMs, panel data models, and small area estimation methods.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Designs advanced statistical estimation methodologies for official publication.

name: Time Series & Seasonal Adjustment
description: Trend, seasonality, cyclical and irregular decomposition (X-13ARIMA-SEATS), ARIMA modelling and macro forecasting.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No time series experience.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands trend, seasonality, and stationarity concepts.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Performs moving average smoothing and computes growth rates.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Runs automated seasonal adjustment pipelines and estimates ARIMA models.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Handles trading day / calendar effects and builds multi-step vector autoregression (VAR) models.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Develops official nowcasting algorithms for high-frequency economic monitors.

name: Python for Data Analysis
description: Data wrangling, cleaning, automation and analytics using Pandas, NumPy, Scipy and Jupyter for official statistical pipelines.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No programming knowledge.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Can read simple scripts and run Python interpreter commands.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Writes scripts using Pandas to filter, group, and merge tabular survey files.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Builds robust end-to-end data transformation pipelines and writes reusable functions.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Optimises memory for large microdata sets (Polars/Dask), writes tests, and builds internal modules.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Architects enterprise data processing systems and sets organisation-wide coding standards.

name: R Statistical Computing
description: Statistical modeling, survey analysis using the 'survey' package, tidyverse workflows, and R Markdown reporting.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No R experience.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Familiar with RStudio and basic vector arithmetic.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Uses tidyverse (dplyr, ggplot2) for data preparation and exploratory summaries.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Uses the 'survey' package (svydesign, svymean) for official survey weighting and error estimation.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Creates automated reproducible reports using Quarto/RMarkdown and develops custom R packages.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Leads institutional adoption of open-source statistical software and reproducible pipelines.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Relational querying, multi-table joins, subqueries, indexing, window functions, and schema design for statistical data warehouses.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No database knowledge.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands tables, rows, primary keys, and basic SELECT queries.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Writes SELECT with WHERE, GROUP BY, and simple INNER/LEFT JOIN statements.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Writes complex multi-table queries, window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG), and CTEs.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Designs normalised schemas, creates indexed views, and optimizes query execution plans.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Designs large-scale distributed database architectures for administrative registry integration.

name: Data Visualisation & Dashboards
description: Visual storytelling, chart design principles, interactive dashboards (PowerBI / Tableau / Apache Superset / Plotly) for statistical dissemination.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No data visualisation skills.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Creates basic bar charts and line graphs in spreadsheets.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Selects appropriate chart types for categorical vs continuous variables without misleading axes.

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Builds interactive multi-page dashboards with drilldowns, filters, and clear annotations.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Designs responsive, accessible visualisations compliant with government web design standards.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Leads national statistical portal visualisation strategy and public data transparency initiatives.

name: Data Governance & Ethics
description: Principles of Official Statistics (UN-FPOS), data anonymisation, privacy regulations (DPDP Act), confidentiality and metadata standards.

levels.name: None
levels.description: No governance awareness.

levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: Understands respondent confidentiality and basic data privacy expectations.

levels.name: Basic
levels.description: Applies standard anonymisation rules (k-anonymity, suppression of cell counts under threshold).

levels.name: Working
levels.description: Ensures full compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and statistical disclosure control protocols.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: Formulates institutional data sharing agreements, microdata release policies, and differential privacy protocols.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Shapes national data governance legislation and international ethics councils for statistical authorities.
